correctness.rationale: Let ω be nondecreasing modulus and m=minτ>0, K=maxτ<∞. Dyadic monotonicity gives Ω(r)=Σ_{n≥0}ω(2^-n r) ≤ ω(r)+(log 2)^-1 ∫_0^r ω(s)/s ds; hence Ω(r)<∞ and Ω(r)→0. Exact full-shift stable/unstable metric contraction at rate 2^-n yields absolutely and UNIFORMLY convergent forward/backward time corrections, tails bounded Ω(2^-n r). Wen Lemma 3.1 interior-return induction needs only ω(2ε)+Kε<m/2; Lemma 3.2 needs summable modulus, giving Bowen–Walters closeness ≤2^-n r+Ω(2^-n r)/m. Local base-shift product, stable/unstable graph-coordinate formulas and total time error ≤(K/2)ε+(1/2)ω(ε)+2Ω(ε) construct the unique small-time bracket. The argument proves every positive continuous Dini roof, no finite computation needed; it does not prove that Dini is necessary. Source RESULT.md contains a literal form-feed escape typo in the displayed time estimate, a presentation defect readily disambiguated from the surrounding argument.
residual_risks: The BW metric stable/unstable precise definition follows Wen; the proof is a generalization of his estimates, not an independent axiomatization of all possible suspension metrics.
The theorem treats the full two-symbol shift with the specified metric, not arbitrary symbolic bases/expansive flows.
The form-feed presentation error should be sanitized before public reuse; it does not alter the logically reconstructible theorem.

value.rationale: Natural structural boundary: Wen exhibits an expansive shadowing suspension where a logarithmically varying roof destroys local product and proves positive Hölder roofs succeed. Dyadically summable (Dini) roof variations are precisely the mechanism ensuring stable/unstable time-holonomy convergence, and Dini is strictly weaker than every fixed Hölder power. This supplies a useful new robust sufficient class of roofs and an explanation of the log counterexample via divergent harmonic tail. The result is a standalone global sufficient theorem on a natural model, not a finite example, renaming, or arbitrary slice. It does not imply all non-Dini roofs fail and claims no extension to arbitrary bases.
residual_risks: Its proof uses existing Bowen–Walters/Wen technology and adds no new abstract metric-flow theorem; mathematical value is specifically in the sharp regularity mechanism for this full-shift suspension.
Dini sufficiency not necessity, as a rough roof can be cohomologous to a more regular one.
